verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:

segments.text: Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:

verses.text: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.

segments.text: Sing forth the glory of his name:
Make his praise glorious.

verses.text: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

segments.text: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works!
Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.text: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. [Selah

segments.text: All the earth shall worship thee,
And shall sing unto thee;
They shall sing to thy name. [Selah

verses.text: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

segments.text: Come, and see the works of God;
He is
terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.text: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.

segments.text: He turned the sea into dry land;
They went through the river on foot:
There did we rejoice in him.

verses.text: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. [Selah

segments.text: He ruleth by his might for ever;
His eyes observe the nations:
Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. [Selah

verses.text: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;

segments.text: Oh bless our God, ye peoples,
And make the voice of his praise to be heard;

verses.text: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

segments.text: Who holdeth our soul in life,
And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.text: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

segments.text: For thou, O God, hast proved us:
Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.text: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.

segments.text: Thou broughtest us into the net;
Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.

verses.text: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

segments.text: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads;
We went through fire and through water;
But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

verses.text: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

segments.text: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings;
I will pay thee my vows,

verses.text: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.

segments.text: Which my lips uttered,
And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.

verses.text: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. [Selah

segments.text: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings,
With the incense of rams;
I will offer bullocks with goats. [Selah

verses.text: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

segments.text: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God,
And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.text: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.

segments.text: I cried unto him with my mouth,
And he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:

segments.text: If I regard iniquity in my heart,
The Lord will not hear:

verses.text: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

segments.text: But verily God hath heard;
He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.text: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.

segments.text: Blessed be God,
Who hath not turned away my prayer,
Nor his lovingkindness from me.
